threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Tube is reliable enough to plan your day around. Welcome to the unpredictability of Hackney!
Caught a night bus home and the driver interrupted a full-on argument between two mates over whose turn it was to pay for the next round. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when the kebab shop owner remembered my order and offered me extra spicy on the house. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab shop selling vegan döner that’s somehow just as messy as the meat version. It's a local rite of passage!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can dodge a Muni bus like it’s a game of Frogger while simultaneously sipping on a açaí bowl.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a dog casually taking a nap on the Civic Center tracks while Muni drivers tried to navigate the chaos. Only in SF do we take naps where we please.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and plazas, but it’s the evening street performances that really capture the neighborhood's heartbeat.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they meticulously check the time on their phone before hopping on the metro, even when it's running late.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can catch a Tube during a strike. Locals just grab a bike and keep it moving. Strikes are part of life here.
Last night on the 381, a guy serenaded the whole bus with obscure 90s pop. Even the driver was chuckling. Only in Bermondsey, I swear.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was really home when I saw a busker playing accordion outside a döner shop, and people were dancing between the kebab orders.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find kebab shops putting out tables and chairs for late-night diners, blending Turkish tradition with Berlin's night life.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they know which Muni line to avoid when there’s a dog on the tracks at Civic Center. A commuter just waits clueless.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, I saw a guy in a full Spider-Man costume hop off the 47, web slinging through the Tenderloin. Only in SF would that be a Tuesday.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí and parks, but the real charm lies in our hidden corners and the evening chatter over vermut in local bars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they line up at the metro machines, fumbling with cash instead of using a T-Casual card.
